goals.objective: Refactor the local skills/ folder according to the already-read instructions/ skill-authoring guidance. Preserve existing domain logic, normalize SKILL.md contracts, routing, support-file discoverability, bilingual mirrors, and validation evidence. Do not modify global home-directory skills/config. Execute via start-work delegation with evidence.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/data surface: run node skills/validate-skills.mjs --json and require success=true, zero missing canonical contract tags, zero missing support links, zero bilingual pair errors, and all canonical SKILL.md files under the line budget.

Scope-boundary data surface: run git diff --name-only and require changed paths are limited to skills/, .omo/, and no global/home-directory paths; also inspect validator adversarial report for prompt-injection/source-boundary and dirty-worktree classifications.
Regression CLI surface: run node skills/product-detail-maker/scripts/validate-product-detail-maker-skill.mjs and node --check for every .mjs script under skills/; require all exit 0 after refactor.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/skills-instructions-refactor/regression-product-detail-and-scripts.txt with command outputs and cleanup receipt.
